# Dark Media

> Dark Media is a premier full-service digital agency specializing in Web Development, Strategic Branding, Video Production, SEO & Analytics, and Social Media Management. Serving 400+ brands across India (Mangaluru HQ) and the GCC region (Dubai, Riyadh, Muscat).

## Core Capabilities

- [Web Development](https://www.darkmedia.tech/services/web-development): Modern Next.js e-commerce platforms, corporate websites, and enterprise web applications.
- [Branding Agency](https://www.darkmedia.tech/services/branding): Visual identity design, brand strategy, typography, guidelines, and corporate rebranding.
- [Video Production](https://www.darkmedia.tech/services/video-production): High-end corporate films, TV & digital ad commercials, and next-gen AI video production.
- [SEO & Growth Analytics](https://www.darkmedia.tech/services/seo-analytics): Data-driven organic search strategy, local SEO domination, and technical site performance audits.
- [Social Media Management](https://www.darkmedia.tech/services/social-media-management): High-ROI performance marketing (Meta, Google, LinkedIn) and viral short-form video reels studio.

## Target Geographies & Regional Hubs

- [Mangaluru Headquarters](https://www.darkmedia.tech/locations/mangaluru): Primary development & creative engineering hub in Karnataka, India.
- [Dubai Regional Hub](https://www.darkmedia.tech/locations/dubai): Serving UAE enterprises with luxury digital experiences and multi-currency web solutions.
- [Riyadh Growth Center](https://www.darkmedia.tech/locations/riyadh): Supporting Saudi Vision 2030 corporate initiatives with bilingual media production.
- [Muscat Agency Center](https://www.darkmedia.tech/locations/muscat): Corporate web development and branding services tailored for Oman enterprises.
